issue: GEM has this Totisa Holdings proposal as 'proposed' (LastUpdated 2025-06-18), but the project was effectively killed in late 2025 and withdrawn by the sponsor. On 2025-10-15 the Canary Islands government's Directorate for Ecological Transition issued an UNFAVORABLE Environmental Impact Declaration (DIA). Following that, Totisa Energía formally WITHDREW its port-concession application ('desistimiento') and the Las Palmas Port Authority board accepted the withdrawal and returned the provisional guarantee (infopuertos article dated 2025-11-13: 'acordó tener por desistida a la empresa TOTISA Energía... de su solicitud de concesión portuaria'). Independently, Spain's Ministry for Ecological Transition (MITECO) DEFINITIVELY EXCLUDED Totisa's Las Palmas (and Tenerife) projects from the competitive non-peninsular electricity-regime procedure. Two independent corroborations; the project will not proceed.
